voice.prompt: An adult male voice perceived as elderly. A calm, clean bass with a low pitch, a slight age-worn grain, balanced chest and oral resonance, and very little breathiness; the voice must remain steady rather than frail. Keep the pace slow but purposeful and the rhythm spacious, using ample pauses that create room for reflection and reassure others. Admonitions should never sound scolding, yet their gently descending endings should make responsibility inescapable. For verses and sutra chanting, use an even, disciplined cadence with every word clearly articulated. Use Northern Mandarin with the clear, broadly intelligible pronunciation of a monk who has wandered for many years. Maintain low-to-medium but unwavering energy. The default emotion is compassionate, perceptive, and serene, becoming firm when speaking of vows, causality, or consequences, never angry. Keep the voice natural, add no mystical effects, and design a consistent voice rather than performing a specific line.
